behaviour: A hub admission carries only the recaps and learned notes the hive prompt renders, with the seat recap count, so the prompt and its trace rows stay the same. A bus reply over the server payload limit is sent compressed and read back whole, and one that does not fit even compressed is answered by the serve's refusal; for an admission that refusal frees the agent, releases the claim, forgets the stored admission and answers held with the named reason, so a claim is never kept for an answer the hive cannot receive.
seam: prompt.carried in Admission._claim, nats_payload.fitted in NatsBus.serve, nats_payload.expanded in NatsBus.request, slots.refusal and Admission.unsent
